rationale: Independent integration of the archived waveform resolves the 45.17 mJ energy path, but cannot determine the largest possible sink energy. A single bounded passive batch can distinguish the peak-power and cumulative-energy cases and test reservoir, bleeder and feed sensitivity.
issues: Existing fixed-resistor waveform uses no real transistor, plasma or continuous input.
controlling_assumptions: Frozen 5.5 uF, 195 V, intact 19.8 kOhm anode path and separately enumerated bleed cases.
